_source: Incident review .operations/metrics/perf/2026-10-08/incident-red-main.md + coordinator note 2026-10-09 ~00:15Z. Main's CI failed on two independent causes: the orphan-adopt soak scenario (from 7c731a95e, 17:04Z) and review-pr-io's ledger row id (from ~21:30Z). Each fix PR failed CI on the OTHER cause. Job names are the CI job names of those runs (soak shard / test shard 2); the soak shard number is reconstructed. mainFailingJobs is the live read at 00:26Z 2026-10-09 (run 37863097737); `test` and `daemon-soak` are summary jobs that only gate on the shards. Review round 1 (PR #4527): `passedJobs` is the explicit successful-job evidence a fix PR needs to count as fixing a main cause (a skipped or cancelled job is NOT proof) and `author` is the PR author the owner rule now requires. `author` is the shape `gh pr list --json author` returned live on 2026-10-09 for #4522 and #4532 (`{is_bot:true, login:"app/web-everything"}`); `passedJobs` is reconstructed from the incident narrative (each PR failed only the jobs in `failedJobs` and passed the other cause's shard), not read from the live runs.
